description: This file defines a template class 'FlatMap' which implements a sorted vector map of key-value pairs, similar to std::map, optimized for low-memory operations and specific performance characteristics. It includes internal type traits to identify 'plain-old-data' types and provides various methods for insertion, deletion, search, and iteration.

classes.name: FlatMap
classes.description: A template class implementing a sorted vector map of key-value pairs, designed as a near drop-in replacement for std::map with specific performance trade-offs.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts elements from a range, avoiding duplicates, and maintains sorted order with in-place merge sort.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an element by key using binary search with an optimized path for POD types.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes elements by key or iterator.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the first position where a key could be inserted without violating order.

methods.name: upper_bound
methods.description: Finds the position after the last occurrence of a key.

methods.name: equal_range
methods.description: Returns the range of elements matching a key.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts a value by key.
